service_boundary: Represents Perplexity's developer API, not the Perplexity answer engine, Comet, Perplexity Computer, or third-party access to similarly named models.
regional_controls: The reviewed public API documentation does not establish customer-selected processing regions.
retention_controls: API-specific terms and product documentation govern request data; search and research features add external-source retrieval to the processing boundary.
routing: The service can combine model inference with Perplexity-operated search and research, but it is not represented here as a general-purpose provider router.
customization: The service exposes search, research, and model parameters rather than customer-imported model serving.
strengths: Search-grounded APIs combine inference with web retrieval and citations.
Compatibility endpoints support common integration patterns.
tradeoffs: Search-grounded requests have a broader data and source boundary than raw generation.
Regional controls are not prominent in the public docs.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Perplexity API overview, for the Perplexity API

upstream_disclosure.note: The API FAQ states how the operator handles content: "We do not retain any query data sent through the API and do not train on any of your data." No subprocessor is named on a page this review could read.
